title: Only one snapshot PNG updated while the entire sim trajectory changed — other goldens/qos snapshots may be stale
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/qos/65000ms.png b/goldens/qos/65000ms.png
Binary files a/goldens/qos/65000ms.png and b/goldens/qos/65000ms.png differ
+1 b6385cef6036cb9f
+1500 be47272cf1acf1a4
-1500 0ba8219e83bf1b2a
detail: Every tick hash in qos.t1 changed and qos.log.bin was regenerated, yet this chunk updates only goldens/qos/65000ms.png. If other snapshot artifacts exist under goldens/qos/, they are stale and inconsistent with the new run.
recommended_fix: Enumerate all artifacts under goldens/qos/; regenerate every snapshot (PNG, bin, t1) from the same final run so the golden set is internally consistent.

title: catalog_hash changed although seed, logic_hz, and tick count are unchanged
detail: The catalog hash moved while every scenario-generation parameter (seed, logic_hz, ticks) stayed identical, implying the scenario catalog itself changed. If this commit intended only QoS behavior changes, the hash should not move; confirm intentionality.
recommended_fix: Confirm the catalog change is part of this commit and the hash was produced by the regeneration tooling, not hand-edited.

title: Zero of 1500 tick hashes survive the change — total trajectory divergence from tick 1
detail: No tick hash is shared between old and new; state diverges from tick 1. A fix scoped to surge-phase behavior would preserve early ticks. Full divergence signals different scenario content; confirm the golden reflects the intended final state.
recommended_fix: Document why all 1500 ticks diverged; regenerate goldens from a single final build to rule out mixing outputs from intermediate versions.
